events.text: Someone from Accounts Payable says that it is nearly Friday, and looks at you as though you should do something about it.
Priya feels very strongly about the car park. Someone has been moved from a space, and it may be significant.
Your Monthly Status Report may be read. Worth finding out by whom.
Dennis says that nothing on this floor happens without someone upstairs knowing. Dennis says this after the third round.
You agreed with someone in the meeting, and things have got easier since.
